استكمنا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْمَنَا (istakmanā) /is.tak.ma.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# اِسْتَكْمَنَّا (istakmannā) /is.tak.man.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# اِسْتَكْمِنَا (istakminā) /is.tak.mi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
